info.description: Robinhood GLD is a tokenized representation of SPDR Gold Shares (GLD) common stock, issued on Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's own blockchain built to bring tokenized real-world assets on-chain. Each token is designed to track the price of the underlying GLD share, giving holders on-chain price exposure to SPDR Gold Shares's stock. The token is freely transferable and composable across the Robinhood Chain ecosystem. Bundlecat (BUN) is the first token launched on Mosh, a token launch protocol developed by UV Labs and deployed on Robinhood Chain. Mosh pairs new token launches with autonomous AI market-making agents. Under the Mosh model, token bundles are crowd-funded by participants and permanently locked in non-custodial smart contract vaults at the moment of launch. AI agents then use the locked tokens to provide liquidity and generate buy-side market activity, operating within contract-enforced rules that no individual, including the Mosh team, can override.
